records.raw_text:  Kharif sowing data collection has started from 05 th June, 2026 and the sowing is in preliminary stage. As on 25 June 2026, the area sown under Kharif crops is 182.72 lakh ha (including 57.31 lakh ha in Sugarcane) as compared to 236.46 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
